data.name: Confusing Strike
data.description: When the investigator deals damage with studied strike, the opponent must succeed at a DC %1 Fortitude saving throw or become confused for 1d4+1 rounds. A successful saving throw reduces the duration to 1 round.  Constructs, mindless creatures, oozes, plants, undead, incorporeal creatures, and creatures immune to critical hits are not affected by this ability. * Only one of these talents can be applied to an individual attack.|InvestigatorConfusingStrikeDC
